physical_query.R10A: 物理读取复用冻结原生attention.q及norm_q；独立可训练K/V/O、时间映射、state_value和零值参考。
physical_query.R15B: 同样复用冻结原生attention.q/norm_q。新增的是物理值先绑定到原请求词，再由视频状态读取的串行寻址；没有独立physical Q矩阵。
physical_query.R15H: 独立复制并训练physical query和query_norm；改回直接读取C，另有semantic_query修正原生文本读取。不能把H描述成只在B上加一个语义输出、其余融合完全相同。

inference_evidence.normal_vs_semantic_off: 当前已看4例几乎保留相同主要缺陷；3个周期纹理案例关语义响应仍有纹理。
inference_evidence.normal_vs_no_c: 同权重全关时3个周期纹理案例清除网格；尺子等仍有其他生成缺陷。

pending_query_test: 已有native_physical_query固定16例模式将替换成原生Q/norm；它回答当前H训练参数对查询的敏感性，不是重新训练的架构消融。
design_constraint: 不会因H整体失败就断言独立物理Q普遍无效，也不会把历史R10A/R15B的PC收益误归给它们并不存在的独立物理Q。具体结构/参数化依据对照选择。

R1.C: native anchor + projected Q refinement; same C supplies physical K and V; alignment applies to that shared C.
R1.memory: Full frozen Qwen input memory including its contextual visual/request tokens.
R1.physical_query: Frozen native Q/norm reused; independently trained physical K/V/O and state interaction.

R9.C: Same anchor-plus-refinement form shared by K/V.
R9.memory: Fitted physical words and literal request words; grounded/global head split.

additional_source_review.R10A_R15B_R15H: Identical Enhancement/ContentBlock: routing comes from grounded source-value read; execution comes from Q refinement, both retain native anchor. These are different value constructions, despite shared query/refinement parameters.

R15G.C: Routing retains native anchor. Execution removes native anchor and uses a free learned shared prior plus projected input-value read.
R15G.caution: G changed other fusion pieces too and failed quality; it does not independently prove source-derived values or removing the anchor is beneficial.

additional_source_review.interpretation: These are verified structural facts. Shared ingredients in better versions are references, not proof that every common component is independently effective. Preserve actual paired evidence when deciding I.
